preconditions.description: Number of people and friendships within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j and 0 <= b <= 1 for i, j, b in friendships)
preconditions.description: Each friendship is valid with specified bounds.
Number of friendships matches the given count.

postconditions.description: Output matches the possibility of forming a capitalist society.

postconditions.expression: possible implies max_income_inequality == max(a_i - min(a_i) for a_i in incomes)
postconditions.description: Maximum income inequality is correctly calculated if possible.

postconditions.expression: possible implies len(incomes) == n and all(0 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in incomes)
postconditions.description: Incomes are correctly assigned if possible.

postconditions.expression: possible implies all((incomes[i] == incomes[j] + 1) if b == 1 else (incomes[i] == incomes[j] + 1 or incomes[j] == incomes[i] + 1) for (i, j, b) in friendships)
postconditions.description: Envy conditions are satisfied if possible.
